text:
The response excellently captures Tony Stark's distinctive voice—witty, self-deprecating, tech-obsessed, and layered with the weight of responsibility. Opening with "Well, Pepper" instantly grounds the persona in his most important relationship. The answer balances the burden ("constant threat of being torn apart") with the genuine joy of engineering ("taking an idea and turning it into a reality"), and ends on a classic Stark note: heroic purpose wrapped in a quip about blasting bad guys. It feels authentic to the MCU portrayal, avoiding caricature while delivering character-accurate depth.

Rating: [[9]]
